zh: 不知道大家有没有发现一件特别反常的事：
en: Have you noticed something rather unusual?

zh: 现在人人拿着AI，效率暴涨。
en: Everyone has AI, and efficiency is soaring.

zh: 可绝大多数人的利润、订单，并没有跟着水涨船高。
en: Yet for most people, profits and orders have not risen with it.

zh: 以前做一份方案，大半天时间。
en: A proposal used to take most of a day.

zh: 现在打开AI，十分钟就直接给到三版。
en: Now AI can deliver three versions in ten minutes.

zh: 整理一张数据表，过去来回折腾两个小时，
en: A data table once took two hours of back-and-forth work.

zh: 现在几句话就能生成结果。
en: Now a few sentences can produce the result.

zh: 所有人都感觉自己，
en: Everyone feels that they

zh: 现在做事变快了。
en: are now working faster.

zh: 可一到月底算账，订单没增多，利润没上涨，
en: But at month-end, orders have not increased and profits have not risen,

zh: 项目整体交付周期，也没有明显缩短。
en: and the total delivery cycle has not clearly shortened.

zh: ChatGPT上线快四年了。
en: ChatGPT has been available for nearly four years.

zh: 个人工作效率肉眼可见地提速，
en: Individual work has visibly sped up,

zh: 为什么企业、整个社会的生产力，
en: so why has productivity across firms and society

zh: 没有迎来大家预想中的大爆发？
en: not seen the surge people expected?

zh: 这里不是说AI完全没有拉动生产率。
en: This does not mean AI has had no productivity effect.

zh: 2022年底ChatGPT问世到现在，
en: Since ChatGPT arrived at the end of 2022,

zh: 美国官方劳动生产率依旧保持正向增长。
en: official US labor productivity has still grown.

zh: 真正巨大的反差在这里：
en: The real contrast is this:

zh: 办公室几乎人人在用AI，
en: AI is nearly everywhere in offices,

zh: 宏观层面却迟迟看不到期待的生产力跃迁。
en: yet the expected macro productivity leap is still absent.

zh: 有一份针对5179名客服人员的调研：
en: One study examined 5,179 customer-support agents.

zh: 接入AI助手之后，
en: After an AI assistant was introduced,

zh: 单人每小时处理问题数量平均提升14%。
en: issues handled per worker-hour rose by 14% on average.

zh: 但另一组宏观测算显示，
en: But another macro estimate suggests

zh: 未来十年AI带来的全社会，
en: that across society over the next ten years,

zh: 全要素生产率提升幅度依旧偏温和。
en: AI-driven total factor productivity gains may remain modest.

zh: 岗位上的效率明显提升，
en: Efficiency rises clearly at the job level,

zh: 整个商业体系转化速度却十分缓慢。
en: while conversion across the business system remains slow.

zh: 到底是哪里卡住了？
en: So where is it getting stuck?

zh: 我最近研究了很多这方面的文章，
en: I recently studied many articles on this question,

zh: 最后把这些问题拆成四道门槛。
en: and distilled the problem into four gates.

zh: 第一道门槛：单一任务效率，不等于整条流程效率。
en: Gate one: task efficiency is not end-to-end process efficiency.

zh: 什么意思呢？
en: What does that mean?

zh: AI十分钟写好方案，批量产出报价、生成文案。
en: AI can draft proposals, quotes, and copy in minutes.

zh: 但是客户资料分散在不同的聊天内容当中，
en: But customer information is scattered across chats,

zh: 审批来回等待，库存、交付、售后体系没有打通。
en: while approvals, inventory, delivery, and support remain disconnected.

zh: 这只是其中一个环节提速。
en: Only one part of the chain has accelerated.

zh: 原来的瓶颈不会消失，
en: The original bottleneck does not disappear.

zh: 只是转移到下一个节点继续堵塞。
en: It simply moves to the next node.

zh: 所以不要只盯着AI帮你省下的几十分钟，
en: Do not focus only on the minutes AI saves.

zh: 要看整个业务链条有没有真正缩短。
en: Check whether the entire business chain is shorter.

zh: 第二道门槛：供给快速增加，
en: Gate two: supply can grow rapidly,

zh: 不等于真实需求同步上涨。
en: without real demand rising with it.

zh: 以前一天最多产出三张设计图，
en: A designer might once have produced three images a day.

zh: 借助AI，一天三十张甚至三百张都不难。
en: With AI, thirty or even three hundred is possible.

zh: 但是客户的需求不会因为生产速度变快，
en: But customer demand does not grow simply because output is faster,

zh: 凭空扩大一百倍。
en: or multiply a hundredfold from nowhere.

zh: 当所有人都能低成本批量产出方案、图片、文案，
en: When everyone can cheaply mass-produce plans, images, and copy,

zh: 市场最先出现的不是价值爆发，
en: the first market outcome is not necessarily a value boom,

zh: 而是严重同质化，价格持续内卷下跌。
en: but sameness and downward price pressure.

zh: 产出越多，越要想明白一件事：
en: The more you produce, the clearer one question must become:

zh: 你做出来的东西到底解决了谁的痛点？
en: Whose pain does your output actually solve?

zh: 谁会持续使用？
en: Who will keep using it?

zh: 谁愿意为最终结果付费？
en: Who will pay for the final result?

zh: 第三道门槛：单纯降低成本，
en: Gate three: lowering cost alone

zh: 不等于创造全新价值。
en: is not the same as creating new value.

zh: 很多企业用AI，目标只有一个：
en: Many firms use AI with only one goal:

zh: 节省工时、精简人手。
en: save labor hours and reduce staffing.

zh: 降本当然有用，
en: Cost reduction is useful,

zh: 但这只是优化旧模式，算不上生产力革命。
en: but it only optimizes the old model; it is not a productivity revolution.

zh: 节省下来的时间，能不能孵化新服务？
en: Can the saved time incubate a new service?

zh: 承接更多原本服务不了的客户？
en: Can it serve customers who were previously unreachable?

zh: 能不能提升交付质量，创造新的收入来源？
en: Can it improve delivery and create new revenue?

zh: 只有跨过这一关，
en: Only after crossing this gate

zh: AI才不只是加速旧工作，
en: does AI do more than speed up old work,

zh: 而是打开一个全新的增长空间。
en: and open genuinely new room for growth.

zh: 第四道门槛：技术产生收益，不等于所有人都能分到收益。
en: Gate four: technical gains do not mean everyone shares the benefits.

zh: 大企业手握自有数据、完整业务流程、充足预算，
en: Large firms hold proprietary data, complete processes, and budgets,

zh: 可以把AI深度嵌入整套系统。
en: allowing them to embed AI across the system.

zh: 中小企业、普通人，
en: Small businesses and ordinary people

zh: 大多数只能使用通用版本和工具。
en: mostly rely on general-purpose tools.

zh: 很多员工的直观感受，
en: For many workers, the immediate feeling

zh: 不是工作变轻松，
en: is not that work becomes easier,

zh: 而是相同时间里需要产出更多内容。
en: but that more output is expected in the same time.

zh: 技术创造收益，和收益如何分配，
en: Creating gains and distributing them

zh: 是两件独立的事情。
en: are two separate questions.

zh: 企业、员工、客户，
en: The firm, the employee, and the customer:

zh: 这笔账不算清楚，效率越高，人的压力反而越大。
en: if this account is unclear, higher efficiency can mean more pressure.

zh: 我之前聊过进场资格、验收证据，
en: I previously discussed access to real contexts and acceptance evidence.

zh: 刚好可以对应到这里。
en: They map directly onto this problem.

zh: 你必须走进真实业务流程，
en: You must enter the real workflow

zh: 找到真正的瓶颈，
en: and find its real bottleneck,

zh: 同时让最终使用者来验收成果。
en: then let the final user accept the result.

zh: 不能拿一段流畅的AI演示，
en: A smooth AI demo cannot be used

zh: 假装生产力已经提升。
en: to pretend productivity has already improved.

zh: 在这里，我并不是否定AI的价值，
en: I am not denying the value of AI,

zh: 也不是说这场生产力革命失败了。
en: nor saying this productivity revolution has failed.

zh: 更加客观的结论是：
en: A more objective conclusion is this:

zh: 前半场，我们把强大的工具交到每个人手里；
en: In the first half, powerful tools reached everyone.

zh: 后半场，改造流程、发掘真实需求、创造新价值，
en: In the second half, we must redesign processes, find real demand, and create value,

zh: 设计收益分配规则，才刚刚开始。
en: while designing how benefits are shared has only begun.

zh: 真正的机会，恰恰在后半场。
en: The real opportunity lies in the second half.

zh: 普通人不用和大企业比拼算力、自研模型，
en: Ordinary people need not compete with large firms on compute or models.

zh: 但你可以深耕一个行业，贴近真实需求，
en: You can go deep in one industry and stay close to real needs,

zh: 更早把AI的作用从“帮我加快干活”，
en: and move AI beyond “help me work faster”

zh: 升级成“帮这件事创造全新价值”。
en: toward “help this work create new value.”

zh: 现在，拿出咱们最常使用AI完成的一项工作，
en: Now take one task you often complete with AI,

zh: 然后问自己四个问题。
en: and ask yourself four questions.

zh: 第一，AI提速了哪一步？
en: First, which step did AI accelerate?

zh: 整条业务流程跟着缩短了吗？
en: Did the whole process become shorter?

zh: 第二，产出变多之后，
en: Second, after output increased,

zh: 谁真正需要、持续使用，并且愿意付费？
en: who truly needs it, keeps using it, and will pay?

zh: 第三，节省出来的时间，
en: Third, did the time saved

zh: 有没有转化成新服务、新客户和新收入？
en: turn into new services, customers, or revenue?

zh: 第四，最终产生的收益，
en: Fourth, from the benefits created,

zh: 企业、员工、客户分别得到了什么？
en: what did the firm, employee, and customer each receive?

zh: 如果只能回答第一个问题，
en: If you can answer only the first question,

zh: 那么你拥有的只是AI效率，
en: you have AI efficiency,

zh: 而不是完整的AI生产力。
en: not complete AI productivity.

zh: 这说明效率和价值中间，
en: This means efficiency and value

zh: 有一段巨大空白。
en: are still separated by a large gap.

zh: 这正是未来几年，
en: Over the next few years, this gap

zh: 普通人、本地实体商家，
en: for ordinary people and local businesses,

zh: 尤其是OPC项目最大的机会。
en: especially OPC projects, is the largest opportunity.

zh: 现在用AI做事的时候，
en: When you work with AI today,

zh: 你卡在这四道门槛里的哪一道？
en: which of these four gates is blocking you?

zh: 评论区聊一聊。
en: Tell me in the comments.

zh: 我是超哥，在兰州AI创业。
en: I am Chao, building an AI venture in Lanzhou.
